promotionRule: Only a validator pass over all seven frozen nonzero-source states, fourteen independently proven nonvacuous Apple consumer executions, and fourteen literal zero-difference source replacements may classify the Tmua source as observationally irrelevant and permit Walle to omit its producer/intermediate over this domain. A positive-control failure is a rejected experiment, not evidence of irrelevance. A source difference identifies the consumer that still requires Tmua. Even a pass leaves current Iscd/Irsd compositor-arithmetic transfer and both Walle product proofs open; it does not authorize production parity or a shader change.
